signature.title: From the first note to the last trace
signature.description: Five scent families, unfolding as you explore.
signature.story_fresh: A light beginning, like the first morning sun. Bright citrus rests on the quiet softness of musk.
signature.story_floral: Petals slowly unfurl. A warm heart of rose with a soft finish that stays close to the skin.
signature.story_woody: Warmth fills the room quietly. Rich amber and balanced woods create an unhurried presence.
signature.story_oud: Eastern depth in a modern expression. Saffron opens into oud with a distinctive trail.
signature.story_night: When everything grows quiet, the fragrance speaks. Dark spices and warm musk for a more intimate moment.
